phase: GitHub top-projects research + permissive copy (patterns/datasets) -> pattern library module; Phase C React skin/persistence and Phase D WebAudio A-B still open
summary: Skenirano 95 unikatnih repoa kroz 9 GitHub upita + 7 velikih referenci (magenta/music21/mido/pretty-midi/JZZ/Tone.js...). Kopiran jedan vendored set po politici permissive licence: gvellut/dmp_midi (MIT) - 468 drum-machine patterna (200 + 260 iz knjiga Rene-Pierre Bardeta) u vendor-max-4.64/dmp-midi/ sa NOTICE.md i sha256 manifest.json (pin na upstream commit 81f926a). Novi stdlib modul dna_midi_studio/pattern_library.py normalizuje korpus, racuna statistike (4/4:429, 12/8:30, 3/4:9; 16-step:390, 12-step:78) i prepoznaje obrasce u pravim MIDI fajlovima (reference-style kick == Rock1MeasureB/Rock7; fixture snare == Rock4MeasureB/R&B2MeasureB/Pop11; song19-01 i session35 takodje). GPL/NC projekti i oni bez licence nisu kopirani (razlozi u 01-github-top-scan.json). Testovi: novi 16/16 (license allow-list, sha256, NOTICE, schema, determinizam, round-trip lookup, stdlib-only) + svi stari zeleni: python 118 (102+16, 3 skip), legacy 5, npm 14/14.
